historical_summary.timing: Serial method-rotated three repeats; routing-only wall time, mapping/source validation/physical compile/MC excluded. Shared host, no claim of paper machine reproduction.

program.dag_depth_unit: One original logical instruction, including retained barriers and measurements; not routing steps, QEC cycles, or physical TICKs.
program.front_metric_scope: Ready-CX count in the recorded ASAP instruction fronts; not the maximum over all delayed schedules. Incomparable CX pairs separately capture other legal choices.
physical_rejection_reasons: Current homogeneous-basis CNOT profile does not preserve these original operations: h, t, tdg, x
The physical profile supports 2..6 logical qubits
Fixed diagonal embedding does not support reverse CNOTs
Source routing profile requires all declared logical qubits to participate
program.semantics_policy: All original operations and classical dependencies retained; custom definitions expanded without deleting gates. No CNOT-only projection is called a full benchmark.
program.model: Pinned author SCMR abstraction: CX/T/TDG occupy one routed step; local Clifford/readout retained as zero-duration logical events. No physical gate timing/noise claims.

input.origin: Frozen specification before evaluation; not used for parameter selection

detail.candidate_pool: Same first 16 candidate orders at the same state
